source: https://allindonesia.imigrasi.go.id (arrival card form: date picker, name and passport filters, flight boxes and arrival-date options read from its front-end in a browser, 2026-10-15) and legacy https://ecd.beacukai.go.id

passport.label: Passport number
passport.help: Printed on the photo page of your passport. Letters and numbers only.

errors.tooShort: Passport number too short — min 6 characters
errors.tooLong: Passport number too long — max 12 characters
errors.invalidChars: Letters and numbers only — no spaces or symbols

full_name.label: Full name (as in passport)
full_name.help: Exactly as shown on your passport. The All Indonesia form keeps letters and spaces only and turns them into capitals.

errors.invalidChars: Letters and spaces only — the form drops anything else

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: DD/MM/YYYY, as the All Indonesia date picker shows it. The calendar runs from January 1920 to today.

errors.tooEarly: The form's calendar starts in 1920 — double check
errors.tooLate: Date of birth cannot be later than today

flight_number.label: Flight or vessel number
flight_number.help: The form has two boxes: the airline code (up to 3 characters, e.g. GA) and the flight number (up to 8), letters and digits only. Check them together here, e.g. GA456. For cruise, use the ship's identifier.

errors.required: Flight or vessel number is required
errors.invalidFormat: Format: airline code + number (e.g. GA456). No spaces.

arrival_date.label: Arrival date in Indonesia
arrival_date.help: DD/MM/YYYY, the date you land in Indonesia. The form offers yesterday, today, tomorrow and the day after, so fill it in within 2 days of arrival.

errors.tooLate: Too early — the form takes arrivals up to 2 days ahead
errors.tooEarly: The form goes back only to yesterday

port_of_entry.label: Port of entry
port_of_entry.help: Picked from the form's Port of Entry list after you choose air, land or sea. CGK = Jakarta, DPS = Bali, SUB = Surabaya, BPN = Balikpapan.

accommodation.label: Address in Indonesia
accommodation.help: For a villa, Airbnb or private home; hotels are picked from a list on the form. The official box keeps letters, digits, dots, hyphens and spaces in capitals, so commas and slashes disappear.
